corrected_efficiency_claim: On the fixed N=200 efficiency subset, measured with the true adaptive WHEN->WHERE->WHAT execution order (evidence-phrase generation and Grounding DINO invoked only after the confidence gate elects to replay), corrected AGIR-DINO runs 244.5% slower than Direct and 19.5% faster than always-on DINO replay, avoiding evidence-generation, DINO, and replay-generation calls on 46.0% of samples.
primary_accuracy_claim: On Qwen, the corrected confidence-only AGIR-DINO policy achieves 64.63% accuracy versus 64.19% for Direct. The difference is numerical rather than statistically supported under the predeclared multiplicity-controlled paired testing.
fused_comparison_nuance: The unadjusted paired-bootstrap interval for AGIR-DINO versus always-on fused excludes zero, but the exact McNemar comparison does not survive the predeclared Holm correction (raw p=0.0595, Holm-adjusted p=0.1784); therefore we do not claim a statistically significant improvement.
do_not_write: statistically indistinguishable from every baseline (without the fused-comparison nuance above)
